items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: Woody’s band I mean — playing slowly, that’s it yeah — one of the first nights we played “Early Autumn” which obviously featured the saxes. And the lead tenor player, a great musician who is still with us, Frank Tiberi.

ctx.x: Well we were talking about swing and Stan.

Yeah. Woody’s band I mean — playing slowly, that’s it yeah — one of the first nights we played “Early Autumn” which obviously featured the saxes. And the lead tenor player, a great musician who is still with us, Frank Tiberi. Frank Tiberi would lay back so far on the beat it’d almost put you back a year. I mean he just [scats]. So one of these early nights I decided to go with the saxophones instead of keeping the pulse, I tried to phrase with them. And Woody goes, “No, no, no! Keep it up, keep it up!” All right?…
